definitions.explanation: The academic term that comes after the current one. Used in schools and universities, often paired with course planning or schedule talk.

examples.japanese: {来学期|らいがっき}は{忙|いそが}しくなりそうだ。
examples.english: Next semester looks like it'll be busy.

examples.japanese: {来学期|らいがっき}は{中国語|ちゅうごくご}を{取|と}るつもりだ。
examples.english: I plan to take Chinese next semester.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}は{来学期|らいがっき}も{同|おな}じ{授業|じゅぎょう}を{担当|たんとう}するらしい。
examples.english: The teacher will apparently be in charge of the same class next semester too.

notes:
Compound of {来|らい} (coming, next) + {学期|がっき} (academic term). Pattern matches {来週|らいしゅう} (next week), {来月|らいげつ} (next month), {来年|らいねん} (next year).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {来学期|らいがっき}の{授業|じゅぎょう}: next semester's classes
- {来学期|らいがっき}{始|はじ}まる: next semester begins
- {来学期|らいがっき}に{向|む}けて: in preparation for next semester

RELATED WORDS:
- {今学期|こんがっき}: this semester
- {前学期|ぜんがっき}: last (previous) semester
- {新学期|しんがっき}: new term (often the start of a school year)
